idea: Фиксировать причину отказа для каждого поиска: нет файла, права, CRS, версии, корпусной связки или качества.

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2
idea: Для будущего добровольного экспорта подготовить перечень нужных сущностей: корпус, секция, стилобат, отметки и CRS.

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2
idea: Запрашивать корпусной экспорт отдельно, чтобы не передавать соседние частные объекты или инженерные сети.

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

question: Q2

question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
question: Q2

author: Sol map pipeline

author: Sol map pipeline
